deregistration_deadline_findings: Law: ER Art. 14(1) (Cabinet Decision 52/2017 as amended by CD 100/2024, consolidated 09-2026 file https://tax.gov.ae/Datafolder/Files/Legislation/2026/Law-No-8-of-2017-and-its-amendments--09-2026.pdf, observed 2026-10-17): 'The Registrant must apply to the Authority for Tax deregistration in the cases mentioned in the Decree-Law, within 20 (twenty) Business Days of the occurrence of any of them.' DL 8/2017 Art. 21 (as amended by DL 18/2022) no longer contains a deadline. Tax Procedures ER (CD 74/2023 as amended by CD 17/2026) Art. 6(5)-(6) only says the FTA reviews deregistration applications per its own rules - no applicant deadline and no FTA processing period; the text contains no '30' business-day figure (searched full text). The 30 BD figure comes only from the FTA VAT Deregistration service page (https://www.tax.gov.ae/en/services/vat.deregistration.aspx, observed 2026-10-17), which states processing '30 business days from the date the completed application was received', a further 30 BD after resubmission, AND that mandatory deregistration applications 'must be submitted within 30 business days from the date the deregistration obligation arouse'. That last statement conflicts with ER Art. 14(1) (20 BD). The FTA Deregistration of Tax Groups page (last updated 30 Sep 2026) says 20 BD for both the application deadline and FTA review. Conclusion: legal deadline = 20 BD (high confidence); 30 BD = FTA service-page processing estimate, with an apparent drafting inconsistency on the application deadline. Agent should cite ER Art. 14(1) for the deadline and present 30 BD only as FTA's stated processing time.
